models.sourceBasis: Nautical Almanac Office Improved Lunar Ephemeris of 1954, derived from E. W. Brown lunar theory and adapted by Astronomy Engine
IMCCE L1.2 analytical theory by Duriez, Lainey and Vienne, translated and optimized by Astronomy Engine

runtime.frameTransform: Astronomy Engine Rotation_EQJ_ECL applied to position and velocity
runtime.evaluation: Local analytical evaluation; no animation-frame network request
runtime.fallback: Unsupported moons retain the explicitly labelled parent-relative circular seed model
runtime.accuracyBoundary: Visualisation-grade analytical ephemerides. Not for spacecraft navigation, occultation prediction, operational timing or ground-track prediction. SpaceViewer does not model limb topography, light time or full satellite attitude here.

validation.generalClaim: Astronomy Engine targets angular accuracy within one arcminute for its supported astronomy calculations
